title: Airport with all black glass windows, boarding spaceship
content: I have a reoccurring dream where I’m entering this airport-like building that is completely made of black glass and it only has one long hallway, leading to a spaceship. Not a plane. There are other people (passengers) but they are all strangers to me. No one talks to me, no one talks to each other. There’s a feeling of overwhelming panic that I can’t actually verbally express in the dream, like all my emotions and actions I want to do- I physically can’t but my mind is going crazy. Once I’m fully on the ship, I can’t remember any events, only the sense of a lot of time passing and having the feeling like you just want to anxiously get to your destination. I eventually wake up and that is how it ends. The feelings this dream give me are just so particular… I’m trying to find the other passengers who might be getting on this plane too.
